title: Friction: the top 5
description: What makes streaming pages and session pages feel broken, measured, each with its smallest fix and its owner.

add.text: Tested 2026-11-09 in a headless phone-width browser (400 px): cards written with the item tool, then /live/, /live/done/ and a session page opened and timed. **Streaming itself works:** a card written by the item tool showed on screen **40 ms** later. What breaks is around it: the session page, what the agent reads back, and what a card shows.
1. Every session page downloads a 256 MB file

**What happens:** opening [this voice chat's session](/framework/ai/sessions/2026/11/06/cloud-voice-app-20261106/) fetched **1,252 files**, one of them `/framework/ai/index.jsonl` at **247 MB**. It says "Reading this session's record…" for 4 s, goes **blank**, then rebuilds; the content settles after **~18 s**.

![Reading for 4 s](/live/plan/friction/1-session-reading.png) ![Then blank](/live/plan/friction/2-session-blank.png)

**Why:** `Server/AIIndex.mjs:374` appends one line per change, and each line is a ~670 KB copy of the whole picture (`stream_line`, line 359 drops only five keys). It keeps up to 400 lines (`KEEP`, line 30, cut at twice that). `ai/rail/DashState.js` tails the file from the start, so every page that shows the AI rail reads all of it.

**Smallest fix:** make the stream line tiny: `stream_line(s){ return { at: s.at }; }` (DashState already refetches `index.json` when a line arrives), and `KEEP = 50`. One line each.

**Owner:** page-index (indexes and load speed).
2. A session page shows the AI dashboard, not the session

**What happens:** at phone width, the first screen of a session page is **In flight / Waiting on you / Next**, the same list as the AI home page. The conversation is below it.

![Dashboard rail on a session page](/live/plan/friction/3-session-dashboard.png)

**Why:** `public/framework/ai/page.js:49` mounts `AIRail` for every url under /framework/ai/ that is not the dashboard itself, and every session lives under it. That is also what pulls in the 256 MB file from #1.

**Smallest fix:** in `content()`, skip the rail when the path is under `/framework/ai/sessions/`, so the session draws full width.

**Owner:** live-page. **Already in flight:** "Session view: a fast, readable page for this session" (live-page, building, on the [Now card](/live/)). Make sure the new view leaves the rail out, or the 18 s stays.
3. The agent and the owner see a different /live/

**What happens:** right now `page_read` on /live/ answers **24 cards** (Back up, Your call, two buttons, two lights…). The screen shows **4**, and so does `item` (`read: "content"` gives total 4). An agent that reads first, as its instructions say, describes a screen the owner is not looking at.

**Why:** the voice agent saved the screen with `{"save": …}` (line 230 of `/live/page.jsonl`). `save` is a LivePage verb. `item` replays /live/ as LivePage, but `page_read` replays it with the generic Page class (`Servex/agents/page_tools.js:1936`, `page_class()`), which skips `save`.

**Smallest fix:** `page_read` takes its class from the same resolver `item` uses, so both read one replay.

**Owner:** page-design (item tool). Related: the plan [one item tool](/live/plan/item-tool/) would retire `page_read`; until then it needs this one-line fix.
4. A card's text never shows on /live/

**What happens:** I wrote a card `{title: "FT-1 A card", text: "First card…"}`, which is the shape the tool's own help gives ("part-card: title, text: a line under it"). Only the title showed. Editing the text later changed nothing on screen. The text is only on the card's own page, one tap away.

![Title only, no text](/live/plan/friction/4-card-text-missing.png)

**Why:** `public/live/LivePage.js:746`: the card's body draws the item's `description`, not its `text`.

**Smallest fix:** draw `text` when there is no `description` (or make the help say `description`). Pick one name for "the line under the title" and use it in both places.

**Owner:** live-page. **Already in flight:** "Card styles: 3 to 5 layouts" (live-page). Fix this first, or every layout inherits the empty card.
5. /live/ opens scrolled to the bottom, past the cards

**What happens:** on load, /live/ scrolls to **2,573 px of 3,260**. The **Now** card sits at 1,223 px, off screen. The first thing seen is the sub-page list, Saved screens and "Removed cards (26)".

![Opens at the bottom](/live/plan/friction/5-live-opens-at-bottom.png)

**Why:** `public/live/LivePage.js:313`: `follow()` pins the scroll box to its bottom on load (chat behaviour). The box also holds the pages list and the footer below the cards (`body()`, lines 304–306).

**Smallest fix:** on load, scroll to the last card, not the bottom of the box; keep the follow behaviour for new cards.

**Owner:** live-page.

- **`item({call, args})` fails on every add:** `args` reaches the tool as a string, so `call: "content.add"` answers "Cannot create property 'parent' on string". The tool's description says to prefer this form. Fix: give `args` a real schema at `Servex/agents/page_tools.js:1903`, or parse a JSON string in `verbs_to_delta` (line 1249). `call: "pages.add"` also answers "no such path"; the `delta` form works. Owner: page-design.
- **Every /live/ page logs 3 warnings:** two broken `{"tabs": {"text": …}}` lines in `/live/page.jsonl` and a List insert refused for `store`/`views`. Owner: live-page.
- **A link card keeps the folder name** ("sub") when its page is made after the card, until a reload. Owner: live-page.
- Load times were fine apart from the session page: /live/ 1.0 s, /live/done/ 0.35 s, /framework/core/Page/ 0.35 s. One card page took 4.7 s once while the index was being rewritten; it was 0.4–0.9 s on two retries.
